$comment: ADDED BY THE SVAR PRODUCTION PLANNER PROJECT. The renderer's icons, authored by this project as plain SVG and inlined into dist-full/index.css by tools/planner-icons.mjs. They replace the wxi icon FONT that @svar-ui/react-core loaded from https://cdn.svar.dev/fonts/wxi/wx-icons.css, which is published on that CDN only and carries no redistribution licence this project could establish. Nothing here is copied from that font or from any third-party icon set: the paths are chevrons, a plus and a cross drawn from scratch on one 24-unit grid with one stroke weight.

authorship.author: SVAR Production Planner project
authorship.licence: same as this repository's own added files

grid.inkInset: 5.25-6.4 units, so the ink is about 0.55em of the 1em glyph box an icon font would have drawn

icons.meaning: this group is expanded — activate to collapse it
icons.state: expanded half of the grid row toggle (pairs with wxi-menu-right)
icons.usedBy: i.wx-toggle-icon[data-action=open-task] in the grid's task-name cell
icons.stemReason: The grid row toggle composes its class from a template literal, so "wxi-menu-down" never appears verbatim in the built renderer. The drift check looks for this stem instead — deliberately weaker, and recorded here rather than tolerated silently.

icons.meaning: this group is collapsed — activate to expand it; also the resizer handle that reveals the chart
icons.state: collapsed half of the grid row toggle (pairs with wxi-menu-down)

icons.meaning: reveal the grid side of the splitter
icons.usedBy: i inside .wx-button-expand-left, visible only while the resizer is hovered
i.wx-action-icon[data-action=add-task] in the grid's action column and header

icons.meaning: remove — delete the selected dependency link
icons.usedBy: i.wx-delete-button-icon inside the link delete button
